name: @cvm/remote
description: The deployed RPC API: a Hono app that exposes the domain operations to a cvm running anywhere, authenticated with a bearer token. No filesystem, no ffmpeg, no OBS — it is the transport and nothing else.

scripts.lint:boundaries: depcruise app.ts auth.ts index.ts runtime.ts version.ts routes
scripts.vercel-build: node scripts/assert-production-source.mjs && pnpm --filter @cvm/core run build && node scripts/assert-migrations-applied.mjs
